hebrewText: אִם תַּגְבִּ֣יהַּ כַּ/נֶּ֔שֶׁר וְ/אִם בֵּ֥ין כּֽוֹכָבִ֖ים שִׂ֣ים קִנֶּ֑/ךָ מִ/שָּׁ֥ם אוֹרִֽידְ/ךָ֖ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה

tokens.bdb: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not

tokens.kjv: exalt, be haughty, be (make) high(-er), lift up, mount up, be proud, raise up great height, upward.
